title: A simple and fast method for fixation of cultured cell lines that preserves cellular structures containing gamma-tubulin
author: Alvarado-Kristensson

steps.title: Generate stable γ‑tubulin shRNA line
steps.instruction: In a 35‑mm tissue‑culture dish, culture U2OS cells and co‑transfect with pTER‑γTUBULIN shRNA and pEGFP‑γ‑tubulin334‑449 plasmids at a 1:1 ratio using JetPei according to the manufacturers’ instructions.

steps.title: Select transfectants with antibiotics
steps.instruction: Two days after transfection, add zeocin to a final concentration of 100 µg/mL and G418 (Geneticin) to 200 µg/mL; refresh medium with the same antibiotic concentrations as needed until the 35‑mm dish reaches confluence (2–3 weeks). Non‑transfected cells will die within 2–3 days.

steps.title: Plate cells for imaging
steps.instruction: When a stable γTUBULINsh‑U2OS–GFP‑γ‑tubulin334‑449 line is established, seed 3 × 10^5 cells into a 35‑mm MatTek glass‑bottom dish and incubate 24 h before imaging.

steps.title: Prepare fixation reagents & microscope
steps.instruction: Place 1:1 methanol/acetone (Met/Ac) at –80 °C and thaw freshly made 4 % paraformaldehyde/2 % sucrose in PBS (Psuc buffer, store at –20 °C for ~2–3 weeks). Warm the microscope incubator (37 °C, 5 % CO₂) for 30 min.

steps.title: Live‑cell imaging and marking
steps.instruction: Mount the MatTek dish in the microscope holder, locate a suitable cell, acquire DIC and fluorescence images (excitation 488 nm, emission 509 nm), and mark the position with a felt‑tip pen (optional: remove and replace the dish to verify the mark).

steps.title: Two‑step fixation (Psuc + Met/Ac)
steps.instruction: Aspirate growth medium, add 500 µL Psuc buffer, fix 3 min at room temperature; then aspirate Psuc, add 1 mL –80 °C Met/Ac, incubate 3 min at –80 °C; finally remove Met/Ac.

steps.title: Alternative single‑step fixation
steps.instruction: If a final Met/Ac step is not required, replace growth medium with 500 µL Psuc buffer and fix 5 min at room temperature (omit the Met/Ac steps).

steps.title: Post‑fixation washes and re‑imaging
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with 1 mL PBS, add 1 mL PBS, return the dish to the microscope holder, relocate the marked cell using the pen, acquire DIC and fluorescence images of the fixed cell, and compare with the live‑cell images.

steps.title: Plate cells for endogenous γ‑tubule imaging
steps.instruction: Culture U2OS and MCF10A cells per supplier instructions. 72 h before imaging, seed 8 × 10^4 cells per 35‑mm MatTek glass‑bottom dish (or 1.1 × 10^5 cells on a 22 × 22 mm coverslip placed in a 35‑mm dish, pressing gently with a pipette tip to keep cells on the coverslip).

steps.title: Fix cells for immunostaining
steps.instruction: Place Met/Ac at –80 °C and thaw Psuc buffer. Remove growth medium, add 800 µL Psuc buffer, fix 3 min at room temperature; then replace with 1 mL –80 °C Met/Ac, incubate 3 min at –80 °C; finally remove Met/Ac.

steps.title: Wash and block
steps.instruction: Wash twice with 1 mL PBS. Incubate the sample in 600 µL PBSB (PBS + 1 % fetal calf serum + 0.5 % BSA) for 5 min to prevent non‑specific antibody binding.

steps.title: Primary anti‑γ‑tubulin incubation
steps.instruction: Mix 1.25 µL mouse or rabbit anti‑γ‑tubulin antibody (1:400; Sigma T6557, T3320, T5192 or Abcam ab27074) with 500 µL PBSB, add to the cells, and incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Remove primary solution and wash once with PBSB for 5 min.

steps.title: Secondary Alexa488 incubation
steps.instruction: Mix 0.6 µL donkey anti‑mouse or anti‑rabbit Alexa 488 (1:800; Jackson 715‑545‑150 or 711‑545‑152) with 500 µL PBSB, add to the sample, and incubate 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional second primary/secondary
steps.instruction: If a second target is required, repeat primary incubation with 0.5 µL anti‑α‑tubulin (1:1000; Merck CP06) or 1.25 µL anti‑pericentrin (1:400; Atlas HPA016820), wash 5 min, then incubate with a mixture of 0.6 µL Alexa 488 secondary (1:800) and 0.3 µL Cy3‑conjugated secondary (1:800; Jackson) in 500 µL PBSB for 1 h.

steps.title: Final washes and preparation
steps.instruction: Wash twice with PBSB for 5 min each. If cells are on a MatTek dish, remove PBSB and add 1 mL PBS. Place the dish in the microscope holder and locate cells displaying γ‑tubules, centrosomes, and microtubules.

steps.title: Mount coverslip (if used)
steps.instruction: For coverslip samples, place a drop of Vectashield (Vector H‑1000) on a Superfrost plus slide (WWR 48311‑703), mount the coverslip, wipe off excess Vectashield with tissue paper, seal with nail polish, and let dry 5 min.

steps.title: Final imaging
steps.instruction: Examine the slide (or dish) to identify U2OS and MCF10A cells containing γ‑tubules, centrosomes, and microtubules, and acquire the desired fluorescence/confocal images.
